title: 阿科松博水壩~Akosombo Dam
focus: 以阿科松博土石壩廣域湖泊與發電放流界面學習~Studying Akosombo embankment lake storage and generation-release interfaces
summary: 本課以以阿科松博土石壩廣域湖泊與發電放流界面學習為主線，先用堆石濕陷與水位與合成核心應力轉移界定水力與構造條件，再將共用設備與可用率、廣域湖面與庫容連結到枯水容量與年能量。業主確認壩型與建設年代；公開頁高度長度互有矛盾故不採用，下列工程數值全為教學假設。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops studying Akosombo embankment lake storage and generation-release interfaces through Rockfill wetting and settlement and Synthetic core stress transfer, then connects Shared equipment and availability and Broad lake surface and storage to Drought capacity and annual energy. The owner confirms dam type and construction dates; conflicting published heights and lengths are excluded and all lesson engineering values are hypothetical. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 阿科松博壩位於迦納伏爾塔河，業主確認其為堆石壩，原工程建設期為1961至1965年，電廠頁面列示裝置容量1020MW。本課將堆石與過渡層變形、廣域湖泊蓄水及發電放流時序連結，讓容量數字回到水量與設備限制的脈絡。業主同頁對壩高及壩頂長度存在互相不一致的敘述，因此不採用那些尺寸，也不以單一容量推定年度發電。所有單元幾何、流量與效率為教學假設，不能當成阿科松博實際工況或核准操作程序。~Akosombo stands on Ghana’s Volta River. The owner confirms rockfill construction during1961–1965 and lists1020MW for the plant. This course connects embankment transitions, broad-lake storage and generation-release timing. Conflicting height and crest-length statements on the owner page are excluded, and installed capacity does not determine annual energy. Every lesson geometry, flow and efficiency is hypothetical rather than an Akosombo operating condition or approved procedure.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查堆石濕陷與水位：SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m；再獨立檢查合成核心應力轉移：PrescribedNormalTotalStress=500 kPa; porePressure=350 kPa; effectiveNormalStress=500-350=150 kPa。敏感度：固定淨水頭60m與效率0.9，流量由200增至250m3/s，出力由105.948增至132.435MW；若尾水隨放流上升，實際增加會小於此固定水頭推估。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。業主確認壩型與建設年代；公開頁高度長度互有矛盾故不採用，下列工程數值全為教學假設。 將比較壩前水位波浪紀錄與壩頂沉陷並標明浪向作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Rockfill wetting and settlement: SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m. Independently examine Synthetic core stress transfer: PrescribedNormalTotalStress=500 kPa; porePressure=350 kPa; effectiveNormalStress=500-350=150 kPa. Sensitivity: at fixed60m net head and0.9 efficiency, increasing discharge from200 to250m3/s raises output from105.948 to132.435MW. Rising tailwater would reduce the gain relative to this fixed-head estimate. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. The owner confirms dam type and construction dates; conflicting published heights and lengths are excluded and all lesson engineering values are hypothetical. Use the following independent check: Compare near-dam water levels and waves with crest settlement and wave direction. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 堆石濕陷與水位~Rockfill wetting and settlement
units.title: 堆石濕陷與水位~Rockfill wetting and settlement
units.mechanism: 堆石壩蓄水可能改變顆粒接觸與破碎，濕潤後變形需與施工壓實沉陷分開。平均軸向應變乘厚度只估均勻壓縮量，不能代表整壩三維沉陷；應以分區材料試驗與蓄水前後測點反應建立對照，避免只看壩頂總量。 驗證時應比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎，並辨識以下失效情境：濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Wetting can change rockfill contacts and breakage, and its deformation should be separated from construction settlement. Mean axial strain times thickness describes uniform compression only, not the three-dimensional dam. Compare zoned material tests with pre- and postimpoundment markers rather than relying on crest settlement alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.
units.verify: 比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。~Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形。診斷時應採取以下查核：比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.
units.misconception: 所有蓄水後沉陷都只是施工壓實尚未完成~Every postimpoundment settlement merely reflects unfinished construction compaction
units.practice: 交接時以比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 合成核心應力轉移~Synthetic core stress transfer
units.title: 合成核心應力轉移~Synthetic core stress transfer
units.mechanism: 合成土石壩核心與兩側材料剛度不同時，拱效應可能把部分豎向荷載轉移到較硬區，降低核心局部總應力。單一有效應力差只呈現孔壓餘量，不能直接預報水力劈裂；需評估最小主應力、材料拉伸特性與接觸變形。 驗證時應比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差，並辨識以下失效情境：用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~In a synthetic zoned dam, stiffness contrast can transfer vertical load away from the core. A scalar effective-stress difference illustrates pressure margin but does not predict hydraulic fracture. Evaluate minimum principal stress, tensile behavior and interface deformation instead of treating average overburden as the complete stress state. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：PrescribedNormalTotalStress=500 kPa; porePressure=350 kPa; effectiveNormalStress=500-350=150 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: PrescribedNormalTotalStress=500 kPa; porePressure=350 kPa; effectiveNormalStress=500-350=150 kPa. units.anchor: 反濾過渡與細粒~Filter transitions and fines
units.title: 反濾過渡與細粒~Filter transitions and fines
units.mechanism: 堆石與細粒防滲材料之間需要連續過渡，否則粒徑反差可能讓細土移入大孔隙。示意粒徑比只供辨認幾何尺度，不是所有土類的核准準則；材料分離、施工污染及交界厚度都須以分區取樣與試驗確認。 驗證時應於實際鋪築位置取樣核對界面兩側級配與連續厚度，並辨識以下失效情境：只驗料場級配會漏掉運輸鋪築造成的分離。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Transitions between rockfill and fine barrier material must remain continuous to prevent fines entering large pores. An illustrative grain-size ratio identifies scale but does not approve every soil type. Verify segregation, contamination and interface thickness through zoned sampling and applicable material tests. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Sample placed material to check both interface gradations and continuous thickness. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Testing only the stockpile misses segregation during transport and placement. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 分孔洩流與不均流~Multiple bays and uneven discharge
units.title: 分孔洩流與不均流~Multiple bays and uneven discharge
units.mechanism: 多孔溢洪道的總流量由各孔實際開度與水頭決定，孔數平均不代表局部水舌或下游壓力相同。合成各孔流量加總只是水量帳；閘門組合改變可能使相鄰水舌交互作用，須對照下游消能與岸坡反應。 驗證時應同步記錄各孔開度與下游水舌位置並核對總流量，並辨識以下失效情境：相同總洩量的不同孔組合可能集中衝擊單側岸坡。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Total spillway flow sums actual bay discharges, not an assumed uniform share. Adding synthetic bay flows is only mass accounting. Different combinations can alter jet interaction and downstream pressure, so check dissipation and bank response alongside opening and head at each bay. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 共用設備與可用率~Shared equipment and availability
units.title: 共用設備與可用率~Shared equipment and availability
units.mechanism: 共用啟閉設備使多個閘門在維修與故障時具有共同依賴，不能把各孔當完全獨立備援。串聯可用率乘積僅適用獨立失效及簡化狀態，現場共因故障需另建事件樹；應檢查設備移動時間、停機及替代方案。 驗證時應以故障維修紀錄分辨共用與獨立設備並核對替代啟閉能力，並辨識以下失效情境：共用啟閉機停機可同時限制多個原本完好的閘門。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Shared hoisting equipment creates common dependencies among gates. Multiplying availabilities represents an ideal independent series system only; common-cause failures require another model. Examine movement time, outages and alternatives instead of counting every gate as fully independent redundancy merely because the leaves are separate. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use maintenance records to distinguish shared and independent equipment and check alternative actuation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A shared hoist outage can constrain several otherwise functional gates. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Ideal independent gate-and-hoist availability: gate=0.98; hoist=0.95; combined=0.98*0.95=0.931 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Ideal independent gate-and-hoist availability: gate=0.98; hoist=0.95; combined=0.98*0.95=0.931 dimensionless. units.anchor: 機組出力與水頭~Generating output and hydraulic head
units.title: 機組出力與水頭~Generating output and hydraulic head
units.mechanism: 阿科松博提供水庫發電與放流協調的案例，機組出力需用淨水頭而不是壩高。尾水與進水損失會隨流量改變，效率也受工作點影響；合成定效率算例只是能量量級，不能以裝置容量倒推出未量測的流量。 驗證時應以同期電功率流量及上下游水位核對效率範圍，並辨識以下失效情境：用固定最高效率套全年工況會高估發電量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Akosombo provides context for coordinated reservoir generation and releases. Output uses net head rather than dam height; tailwater, losses and efficiency vary with operating point. A constant-efficiency illustration gives an energy scale and does not justify recovering unmeasured flow directly from nameplate capacity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check efficiency using simultaneous electrical power, flow and both water levels. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Applying peak efficiency to every operating state overstates generation. units.anchor: 廣域湖面與庫容~Broad lake surface and storage
units.title: 廣域湖面與庫容~Broad lake surface and storage
units.mechanism: 大面積湖泊的小幅水位變化可能對應大量庫容，但面積並非固定，岸線地形使水位容量關係非線性。以定面積近似只適用短範圍示意，應使用實測地形更新曲線；不同高程基準不能直接拼接成容量變化。 驗證時應以分水位面積曲線與重複測深核對局部容量斜率，並辨識以下失效情境：固定面積外推大幅洩降會錯估可用庫容。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A small level change over a broad lake can represent substantial storage, but shoreline geometry makes area variable. A constant-area approximation covers a limited range only. Update the relation from bathymetry and keep vertical datums consistent rather than joining unlike surveys into a storage trend. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check local storage slope using stage-area curves and repeat bathymetry. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Constant-area extrapolation over large drawdown misstates usable storage. units.anchor: 風浪水位與壩頂~Wind setup and crest checks
units.title: 風浪水位與壩頂~Wind setup and crest checks
units.mechanism: 廣域湖泊的風作用可能造成平均水位壅高與短時波浪，兩者應分開並與壩頂高程比較。簡化淨餘高只是已指定工況的幾何帳，不能替代波浪爬升或可靠度分析；還需考慮沉陷、浪向與岸形聚焦。 驗證時應比較壩前水位波浪紀錄與壩頂沉陷並標明浪向，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略壩頂長期沉陷會高估剩餘餘高。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Wind over a broad lake can produce both setup and waves, which must be distinguished in crest checks. A geometric clearance calculation applies to a prescribed case and does not replace runup or reliability analysis. Settlement, direction and shoreline focusing also affect local conditions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare near-dam water levels and waves with crest settlement and wave direction. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring long-term crest settlement overstates remaining freeboard. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 下游流量爬升~Downstream discharge ramping
units.title: 下游流量爬升~Downstream discharge ramping
units.mechanism: 發電調峰會改變下游放流時序，平均日水量相同仍可能造成不同水位變化速度。流量差除時間只是放流變率，不能直接等同下游任一斷面的水位升速；河道儲水、傳播時間與支流入流需用路由與量測評估。 驗證時應同步記錄電廠放流與下游多站水位以辨認傳播延遲，並辨識以下失效情境：把出口流量變率直接當居民區水位升速會混淆量綱。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Peaking changes release timing even when daily volume is unchanged. Discharge change divided by time is a release ramp, not the water-level rise at every downstream section. Channel storage, travel time and tributaries require routing and observations to determine actual downstream response. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record plant release and downstream levels at several stations to identify travel delay. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Equating outlet discharge ramp with settlement-area level rise confuses dimensions. units.anchor: 枯水容量與年能量~Drought capacity and annual energy
units.title: 枯水容量與年能量~Drought capacity and annual energy
units.mechanism: 枯水期間可用水量與水頭可能同時下降，使裝置容量與實際年電量差距擴大。容量因數用年能量除額定功率與時數，僅是事後或情境指標，不直接說明停機原因；需分辨水文限制、設備故障與電網需求。 驗證時應將停機紀錄入流與限載原因對照年電量而非只看單一比率，並辨識以下失效情境：容量因數下降可能來自缺水而非機組效率劣化。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~During drought both available volume and head may fall, widening the gap between capacity and energy. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare outages, inflow and curtailment causes with annual energy rather than one ratio.
